facts.fact: The report says Egypt launched the National Startup Charter in February 2026, giving a formal startup definition, a certification pathway and a unified policy framework separate from SME regulation, and commits USD 1 billion in financing.
The report lists Law No. 6/2025 as establishing a simplified startup tax regime.

The report says many startups obtained the official "startup label" through standard and fast-track application processes, and names Flend and Olive Finance as Egypt's first nationally certified startups.

The report says Egypt Ventures, the sovereign VC vehicle, has deployed investments across 22 companies to date, and that the MSMEDA Fund of Funds co-invests alongside private VCs with capital deployment ongoing.
facts.system: Egypt Ventures; MSMEDA Fund of Funds
